claim_level_definitions.external_claim_allowed: Project-internal flag indicating whether the project is willing to make a written statement to an outside party that the area behaves as documented. NOT a lender/bank/audit/regulatory/certification/SaaS claim.
claim_level_definitions.pilot_claim_allowed: Project-internal flag indicating whether the area is ready for controlled-pilot exposure to a real human user. NOT a production claim.

global_notes: No area in this matrix currently has external_claim_allowed: true. The project does not make external claims at this time.
Areas with pilot_claim_allowed: true are candidates for the controlled pilot (B7). They are not yet ready for any external claim.
AREA-001 (TUHO) and AREA-002 (Oborovo) are the two narrow-scope targets for promotion to approved_for_narrow_scope after B1 review and a controlled pilot.
AREA-003 (generic solar) and AREA-004 (generic wind) are explicitly exploratory and are not promoted to pilot or external claim by the existence of Oborovo / TUHO as specific projects.
AREA-014 (Phase 51F guardrails) is regression protection, not external validation, and is not promoted to external_claim_allowed by being green.
AREA-015 (Phase 51G-1) is characterization only and depends on Agent A Phase 51G-2 (future /save-run extraction) for promotion.
This matrix is a working artifact. Demotions to weaker categories are encouraged when evidence is found insufficient. See model_evidence_taxonomy.md §6 for the demotion procedure.
